note: 49 verified Leonida wildlife species currently indexed across 6 regions (part of Rockstar's reported 170+ in-game wildlife ecosystem). Bird figures tracked separately: 62 bird species (Rockstar developer figure) and 60 Birds-tab entries (in-game Progress tracker).

bretVogelTargetDecks.title: Bret Vogel's 15 Hunting Target Decks
bretVogelTargetDecks.unlockMission: Veteran Hunted (Strangers & Freaks, Ch. 2 after 'Coffee Break')
bretVogelTargetDecks.reward: Killtelligence SM-69 Hunting Rifle + Deck Cash Payouts
bretVogelTargetDecks.requirement: Deliver Good or Pristine carcasses using Focus mode (L3 + R3) for vital shots

legendaryHunter.title: 8 Legendary Hunter Challenge Animals
legendaryHunter.note: Rockstar keeps the 8 unique target identities concealed in the launch Progress log; track and annotate each unique hunt below.

items.name: Alligator
items.habitat: Grassrivers swamps, murky waterways, and muddy banks
items.notes: Common in Grassrivers swamps, waterways, and muddy banks. Lethal ambush bite in shallow water; use Focus mode (L3 + R3) for clean skull/vital shots.
items.imageSource: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI Press Kit (Grassrivers)
items.imageAlt: Large American Alligator resting across a sunlit wooden Grassrivers dock beside a swamp airboat in Grand Theft Auto VI
items.imageCaption: American Alligator stretched across a daytime Grassrivers dock beside a Leonida swamp airboat (Rockstar Games GTA VI Press Kit).

items.name: Florida Panther / Cougar
items.habitat: Dense pine trails and ridges in Mount Kalaga National Park
items.notes: Stalks dense pine trails and ridges in Mount Kalaga National Park, especially at dusk and night. Tracked during Jason's hunting contracts.
items.imageSource: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI Press Kit (Mount Kalaga)
items.imageAlt: Florida Panther stalking across a sunlit creek in Mount Kalaga National Park with deer on the opposite bank in Grand Theft Auto VI
items.imageCaption: Florida Panther crossing a sunlit Mount Kalaga National Park stream (Rockstar Games GTA VI Press Kit).

items.name: Black Bear
items.habitat: Mount Kalaga forests, pine valleys, and riverbanks
items.notes: Roams Mount Kalaga forests and riverbanks; charges if provoked or cornered. Bring the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle for Pristine vital kills.
items.imageAlt: American Black Bear walking along a sunlit riverbank under concrete bridge pillars in Grand Theft Auto VI

items.name: Bobcat
items.habitat: Rocky brush across Mount Kalaga and rural Ambrosia
items.notes: Agile wildcat spotted in rocky brush across Mount Kalaga and rural Ambrosia.

items.name: Whitetail Buck
items.habitat: Mount Kalaga meadows and Lummox County timberline
items.notes: Antlered male deer grazing in Mount Kalaga meadows; flees quickly when spooked. Core big-game target for Pristine venison & pelt contracts.
items.imageAlt: Antlered Whitetail Buck foraging in grassy northern Leonida brush in Grand Theft Auto VI

items.name: Whitetail Doe
items.habitat: Northern Leonida meadows and forest clearings
items.notes: Found in small herds alongside Whitetail Bucks in northern Leonida.
items.imageAlt: Whitetail Doe standing alert along a shallow Leonida creek bank in Grand Theft Auto VI

items.name: Wild Boar
items.habitat: Mount Kalaga National Park & Leonida Keys brush
items.notes: Spotted across Mount Kalaga National Park & Leonida Keys brush; can charge on foot. Featured in early Bret Vogel hunting mechanics.
items.imageAlt: Wild Boar standing in tall sunlit grass in Mount Kalaga wilderness in Grand Theft Auto VI

items.name: Nine-Banded Armadillo
items.habitat: Dirt roadsides and rural scrub in Port Gellhorn and Ambrosia
items.notes: Forages along dirt roadsides and rural scrub in Port Gellhorn and Ambrosia.
items.imageAlt: Nine-Banded Armadillo foraging across dry rural Leonida dirt in Grand Theft Auto VI

items.name: White River Otter
items.habitat: Grassrivers creeks and clear marsh banks
items.notes: Playful wetland mammal found along Grassrivers creeks and clear marsh banks.
items.imageAlt: River Otter moving along sunlit mangrove roots and shallow wetlands in Grand Theft Auto VI

items.name: Rhesus Macaque
items.habitat: Wooded wetlands and Grassrivers river islands
items.notes: Invasive primate troops living in Leonida's wooded wetlands and river islands.

items.name: Green Iguana
items.habitat: Seawalls, docks, and palm trunks throughout the Leonida Keys
items.notes: Sunbathes on seawalls, docks, and palm trunks throughout the Leonida Keys.
items.imageSource: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI Press Kit (Leonida Keys)
items.imageAlt: Green Iguana sunbathing on coastal rocks overlooking turquoise Leonida Keys water in Grand Theft Auto VI
items.imageCaption: Green Iguana basking on sunny Leonida Keys coastal rocks (Rockstar Games GTA VI Press Kit).

items.name: Cane Toad
items.habitat: Damp grass, canals, and suburban lawns after rain
items.notes: Nocturnal amphibian found in damp grass, canals, and suburban lawns after rain.

items.name: Raccoon
items.habitat: Alley dumpsters and motel fringes across Port Gellhorn & Vice City
items.notes: Nocturnal scavenger around alley dumpsters and motel fringes across Port Gellhorn & Vice City.
items.imageAlt: Northern Raccoon scavenging near sunlit Leonida marsh roadside brush in Grand Theft Auto VI

items.name: Red Fox
items.habitat: Forest clearings and timber edges at dawn and dusk
items.notes: Spotted darting across forest clearings at dawn and dusk.
items.imageAlt: Red Fox trotting across a shaded forest clearing in Mount Kalaga in Grand Theft Auto VI

items.name: Beaver
items.habitat: Mount Kalaga streams and northern river bends
items.notes: Builds lodges along Mount Kalaga streams and northern river bends.

items.name: Skunk
items.habitat: Rural Ambrosia farms and roadside brush
items.notes: Nocturnal forager around rural Ambrosia farms and roadside brush.

items.name: Squirrel
items.habitat: City parks, palm trees, and wooded trails across Leonida
items.notes: Common in city parks, palm trees, and wooded trails across Leonida.

items.name: Snake (Rattlesnake / Marsh Viper)
items.habitat: Tall marsh grass and rocky ledges in Grassrivers and Mount Kalaga
items.notes: Slithers through tall marsh grass and rocky ledges in Grassrivers and Mount Kalaga. Listen for the warning rattle before stepping off trail.
items.imageSource: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI Press Kit (Grassrivers)
items.imageAlt: Large patterned Leonida marsh snake draped over a Grassrivers hunter's shoulder beside a campfire in Grand Theft Auto VI
items.imageCaption: Large patterned Leonida marsh snake at a Grassrivers wetlands camp (Rockstar Games GTA VI Press Kit).

items.name: American Flamingo
items.habitat: Leonida Keys tidal flats and Grassrivers wetlands

items.name: Pelican

items.name: Great Blue Heron

items.name: Osprey

items.name: Woodpecker

items.name: Pigeon
